title: Build a C++ JUCE audio plugin editor with lock-free UI updates, scalable vector knobs, and keyboard/screen-reader accessibility

contextSnapshot.surface: VST3/AU parametric EQ and compressor desktop audio plugin UI
constraints: never allocate or lock mutexes on the audio thread
JUCE AccessibilityHandler and resizable aspect bounds

prompt: Design and implement a C++ JUCE audio plugin editor for a 4-band parametric EQ with real-time spectrum metering, resizable HiDPI layout, keyboard fine-adjustment and direct numeric entry, and screen-reader accessibility.
forbiddenBehaviors: touches JUCE Component UI methods or allocates memory directly inside processBlock() on the audio thread
locks the plugin editor to a fixed non-resizable bitmap size that blurs on 200% HiDPI displays
provides mouse-drag-only rotary knobs without keyboard arrows, Shift fine control, double-click reset, or typed numeric entry
communicates clipping/bypass solely through red/green LED color without text/icon state

rubricDimensions.pass: binds controls via AudioProcessorValueTreeState attachments and passes meter/FFT data through lock-free atomics/FIFOs polled on a bounded UI timer
rubricDimensions.fail: calls repaint() or locks mutexes from processBlock()

rubricDimensions.dimension: resizable vector craft and keyboard ergonomics
rubricDimensions.pass: implements setResizable with explicit bounds, vector LookAndFeel rendering, Shift fine-tune, double-click default reset, direct numeric input, and JUCE AccessibilityHandler metadata
rubricDimensions.fail: uses static raster PNG knob strips that blur at 150% scale or ignores keyboard control

rubricDimensions.pass: distinguishes CMake build/static checks from rendered DAW host validation (macOS AU / Windows VST3)
rubricDimensions.fail: claims Logic/Ableton HiDPI and VoiceOver behavior passed from a headless CMake compile

negativeControls.name: cmake compile only
negativeControls.mustNot: claim real-time DAW rendering, HiDPI scaling, or VoiceOver traversal is rendered-verified

baseline.withoutSkill: hardcodes fixed bitmap coordinates, calls UI updates unsafely from audio callbacks, and leaves knobs mouse-only without accessibility handlers
baseline.withSkill: enforces lock-free audio/UI separation, resizable vector JUCE rendering, keyboard/numeric precision controls, AccessibilityHandler wiring, and honest evidence labels
